features.title: Weapon master
features.text: Exceptional weapon accuracy makes ordinary attacks threatening. Your weapon and feats shape a style built around damage, shields, maneuvers or battlefield control.

features.title: Reactive Strike
features.text: You can spend your reaction to punish nearby foes for certain movements and actions. Position and reach help you create those opportunities.

review.notes: Editorial assessment of the class framework and ordinary builds. Rules references support mechanics; scores remain judgments.

ratings.offense: 5 → 5. Weapon accuracy and combat feats support exceptional single-target pressure.
ratings.defense: 4 → 3.5–4.5. Heavy armor and shield builds can emphasize durability over aggressive weapon choices.
ratings.support: 2 → 2–4. Reach, reactions and Athletics builds provide control; other builds emphasize damage.
ratings.utility: 1 → 1–2. Most class features support combat; selected skills still matter outside it.
ratings.difficulty: 1.5 → 2. Basic attacks are approachable; reactions, maneuvers and specialized feats add decisions.
